info.name: Veggie Delite
info.description: A fresh vegetarian sub packed with crisp vegetables and your choice of flavorful sauces. Light, crunchy, and refreshing, it's a simple everyday favorite.

info.name: Paneer Tikka Sub
info.description: A hearty sub filled with spiced paneer tikka, fresh vegetables, and flavorful sauces. It combines smoky paneer with crunchy vegetables and a soft toasted bread.

info.name: Chicken Teriyaki Sub
info.description: Tender chicken glazed with sweet-savory teriyaki sauce and layered with fresh vegetables in a soft sub. A flavorful combination of juicy chicken, sauce, and crunch.

info.name: Chicken Seekh Sub
info.description: A flavorful sub filled with seasoned chicken seekh, fresh vegetables, and sauces. Savory, filling, and packed with aromatic spices in every bite.

info.name: Veggie Patty Wrap
info.description: A soft wrap filled with a savory vegetable patty, fresh vegetables, and sauces. A convenient vegetarian meal with a satisfying combination of textures.

info.name: Chicken Tikka Wrap
info.description: Tender chicken tikka wrapped with fresh vegetables and flavorful sauces. Smoky, savory chicken makes this a filling and flavorful handheld meal.

info.name: Paneer Tikka Salad
info.description: A fresh salad topped with flavorful paneer tikka and crisp vegetables. It combines refreshing greens with the rich, smoky taste of seasoned paneer.

info.name: Chicken Teriyaki Salad
info.description: A fresh vegetable salad topped with tender teriyaki-glazed chicken. Sweet-savory chicken and crisp vegetables create a light but satisfying meal.

info.name: Potato Chips
info.description: Crispy and crunchy potato chips that make a simple, savory side. They're perfect when you want a light snack alongside your sub or wrap.

info.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
info.description: A soft-baked cookie filled with delicious chocolate chips. Sweet, chewy, and packed with chocolate flavor, it's an easy dessert or snack.
